acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Each environment maintains its own current version when specs uploaded with different environment parameters
GET /api/v1/apis/{id}/versions returns all versions sorted by uploaded_at descending
GET /api/v1/apis/{id}/versions?environment=prod returns only versions for that environment
Version entry includes: id, version, environment, uploaded_at, endpoints_count
New versions stored separately while preserving previous versions (never delete)
Pagination support: page/limit with default 20, max 100
404 Not Found for non-existent API ID
400 Bad Request for invalid environment parameter

entry.title: Architecture
entry.snippet: Defines REST API patterns, error response format, pagination structure, Fastify service injection via decorators, and TypeBox schemas for validation.

entry.title: Architecture
entry.section: ADR-009: Environment as String, Not Enum
entry.snippet: Environment stored as configurable string instead of enum to support varied environment names (dev, staging, prod, qa, canary, preview, etc.).

entry.title: Epic Definitions
entry.snippet: API owner needs to track spec versions per environment so consumers know which version to test against. Each environment maintains own current version with queryable version history.

entry.title: Product Requirements Document
entry.snippet: Version history must be queryable via API with filtering by environment and pagination support. Show version progression across environments.

entry.reason: CRITICAL: ApiVersion already has environment field (String) and endpoints relation. NO MIGRATION NEEDED.
Endpoint model has apiVersionId foreign key - enables _count.endpoints in Prisma queries for endpoints_count.
Singleton Prisma client instance. Import as: import { db } from '../lib/db.js'
Reference service pattern: constructor takes PrismaClient, methods return typed interfaces, direct Prisma queries.
Reference plugin pattern: fp wrapper, declare module 'fastify', fastify.decorate(), dependencies array.
Reference route pattern: TypeBox schemas, typed request generics, schema object with tags/querystring/response, fastify.service access.
Global error handler (147-183): handles 404/401/429/500 with structured error format. Route registration (256-263): protected routes under /api/v1 prefix.
Service test pattern: sequential tests, cleanup functions, try/finally blocks, direct DB assertions.
Integration test pattern: buildApp(), app.inject(), response.json(), cleanup in afterAll/afterEach.

constraints.constraint: MUST preserve all historical versions - never delete old versions
MUST use Prisma ORM conventions for database queries
MUST follow Fastify plugin pattern for service injection
MUST return standard error format: { error: { code, message, details? } }
MUST use TypeBox schemas for request/response validation
MUST enforce pagination limits (max 100 per request)
MUST sort versions by uploadedAt descending
MUST include endpoints_count via Prisma _count relation
Environment is string field (not enum) per ADR-009
NO DATABASE MIGRATION REQUIRED - schema already supports all fields

api.name: VersionHistoryService.getVersionHistory
api.signature: getVersionHistory(apiId: string, options?: { environment?: string, page?: number, limit?: number }): Promise<PaginatedVersionHistory>

existing.name: ApiVersion Prisma Model
existing.signature: prisma.apiVersion.findMany({ where: { apiId, environment? }, orderBy: { uploadedAt: 'desc' }, skip, take, include: { _count: { select: { endpoints: true } } } })

tests.standards: Vitest test framework with sequential test execution. Service tests use direct Prisma queries for setup/assertions with cleanup in try/finally blocks. Integration tests use Fastify app.inject() for HTTP request simulation. Tests require cleanup functions to remove test data. Test files located in src/__tests__/ with pattern: services/*.service.test.ts and routes/**/*.route.test.ts. Use describe() with { sequential: true } for database tests.
